title: Arriving 'gods' will be received as saviours, leading to Armageddon

tellings.quote: And that that group will be received as the gods returning to the earth.

plain: A group of beings will one day arrive on Earth and be welcomed as the gods returning, and that welcome will lead to Armageddon, the final battle at the end of the world. This comes from a researcher named Tim Alberino, who says it in his own words: "that group will be received as the gods returning to the earth." He draws on the Book of Revelation, the last book of the Christian Bible, and on a work called Birthright, and he tells it as a warning that people could mistake their own downfall for salvation.
